label: Bible Study
prompt: The _____ of the LORD are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.
verse: The eyes of the LORD are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.
note: Nothing slips past heaven's notice — the evil and the good alike.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly _____: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verse: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
note: Near the end of his life, Paul is still sure: the Lord will deliver him and bring him safe to His heavenly kingdom.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were _____ afraid.
verse: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.
note: 'Sore afraid' is KJV for terrified — an angel plus the glory of the Lord will do that to a shepherd.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But as many as received him, to them gave he _____ to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:
verse: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:
note: The prologue's open door: not born into it by blood, but receiving him grants the right to be God's children.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are _____ wolves.
verse: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.
note: False prophets in sheep's clothing, 'inwardly ravening wolves' — the original wolf in sheep's clothing.
